title: Carbonexo Dataset V2 factor record
description: One numeric value with full provenance. Schema validity is NOT evidence of scientific correctness; see verification_status and review.

factor_id.description: Stable dotted id: <domain>.<region>.<thing>[.<variant>]. Year-specific DESNZ ids end in .yYYYY.

unit.description: Must contain a denominator, e.g. kg/kWh, kg/pkm, kg/vkm, kg CO2e/kg product.

region.description: Where the value was measured: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (IN, GB, US) or GLOBAL.

applies_to_regions.description: Regions where this may be used as the direct default factor.

proxy_regions.description: Regions where it may be used ONLY with an explicit uncertainty label shown to the user.

gases.description: CO2 | CO2e (state GWP basis where known)

source_locator.description: Table / row id / section in the source.

citation_of_record.description: source_id of the original study when source_id is a redistributor.

scientific_status.description: Fitness for user-facing claims. supported: may be shown and used by tools. provisional: may be used with an uncertainty label. unsupported: production shows 'Not estimated'; demo mode only, with a warning; never passed to the AI as fact.
